entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to talk to someone about a return.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. I can definitely help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Sure, it's VF-8675309. It's for a new helmet I bought.
Thank you. I see the order right here. Okay, so before we proceed, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. The color just isn't what I was expecting from the website photos. I haven't even used it; in fact, the box is still unopened.

I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. And we certainly want you to feel confident in your gear, as that's a key part of road safety. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you.

Alright, I've checked your purchase date. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you. I'll email you the return shipping label and instructions right now.

Okay, that's great news. Now, the return shipping isn't free, is it? Since the color representation on the site was a bit off, would you be able to either cover the shipping or maybe offer a small discount code for my next purchase to offset it?

I appreciate you asking. While I can't offer a discount or credit in this situation, I am happy to process the full refund for the item as soon as it's received back at our warehouse. The return approval is the solution we can provide today.
Alright, I understand. Can't blame a guy for trying. A full refund is fair enough. Please send over that email.
Of course. I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
